after.description:
Android consciousness restrictions coexist with a human consumer society and a later struggle over artificial rights. Artificial service offers a plausible labor-saving material connection, but personhood law alone does not establish a universal human necessities floor. The guarantee best guess is mixed and conditional, with exact household support left broad. This zero variant treats technology and retained occupations as an explicitly cautious comparison rather than assuming every android body is already an active citizen.

 Human consumer, corporate and civic institutions receive positive control weight, qualified by independent awakened artificial agency. Legal constraints do not automatically turn the wider society into an AI government. The modest human nonworking scenario counts services, technical maintenance, administration, care and useful creation. Artificial companions’ contribution remains work where useful to others, while private intimacy or leisure is not automatically a job. Later recognition of rights is not silently assigned a complete new distribution policy for all humans. The ordinary consumer order remains the selected material scope.

guarantees.basis: Consumer service capacity does not settle universal material support.
